text:
incident-bot: PAGER: ap-east2 kvcache pressure detected. Increased cache eviction and higher generation latencies for region ap-east2. Error rate ~4.7% over 10m. Paging oncall @maria. Link: https://incident.redwood/in/2448123456 :rotating_light:

maria: Ack. I'm on it — standing up triage now. Paging SRE and Routing.

maria: Quick triage: memory usage climbing on kvcache pods in ap-east2. Autoscaler failing to add pods due to quota errors on the cluster (API returns 403). This looks like capacity *adds* blocked rather than a full network outage. Generation jobs for long-context (>8k tokens) are timing out or returning 503s.

nic: I can prepare a traffic fallback patch for the Traffic Router. Which service names are seeing the failures?

maria: prod-gen-1 is the main one. Affected customers we see in logs: AcmeCorp-prod, searchly-prod, internal-loadtests. Not all requests, mostly long-context or high QPS flows.

raj: Recommend immediate small-percentage diversion to ap-northeast1 and ap-south1 while we scale or free up cache. We should cap failover to 30% for now to avoid cascading latencies. I'll write the routing patch.

nic: Applying routing patch now. Patch snippet:

```
PATCH /v1/routes/prod-gen-1
{
  "region_fallbacks": ["ap-northeast1", "ap-south1"],
  "max_pct_failover": 30
}
```

nic: Pushing config...

deploy-bot: deploy 2448123570 - traffic-router:prod-gen-1 - initiated by nic. CI checks passed.

maria: Also enabling a temporary kvcache bypass for requests over 8k tokens to reduce eviction pressure. Oncall runbook step: set bypass flag and scale down ephemeral cache shard eviction frequency. Example command to toggle flag in feature-flag store:

```
# toggle kvcache bypass for long-context
curl -X POST "https://flags.redwood/api/v1/toggles" -d '{"key":"kvcache_longcontext_bypass","value":true}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLAG_TOKEN"
```

oli: I'm requesting quota bump for ap-east2 from infra now (cc @maria). If quota approves we can scale additional cache nodes. ETA on quota approval ~20-30m but infra is monitoring.

maria: Support/CX: can you start customer outreach for the top impacted customers? Short note + expected ETA would be good.

support: Starting outreach. Drafting: "We're seeing intermittent increased latency and some timeouts for generation in ap-east2. We're diverting some traffic to nearby regions and working on scaling cache. We'll follow up with updates every 30 minutes." Will send to AcmeCorp and Searchly now; will post status page when docs confirm wording.

docs: Draft status update for status.redwood.com:

```
Overview: We are investigating increased latency and intermittent errors for generation workloads in ap-east2 caused by memory pressure on prefix/KV cache nodes. Impact: Some requests (particularly long-context generations) may experience higher latency or timeouts. Mitigation: We have activated partial regional failover to ap-northeast1 and ap-south1, enabled a temporary long-context cache bypass, and are requesting additional cache capacity. Next update: in 30 minutes. Public ETA: 2 hours for full resolution pending capacity increases.```

/docs: LGTM (small edit: change "2 hours" to "~2 hours" and add contact link).

raj: Handing ops lead to oli in 10m. I'm going to update routing monitor thresholds then drop off. @oli please take lead on mitigation steps.

oli: Taking lead. Current mitigation plan: \n1) Gradual diversion: shift 10% -> 30% -> 50% if metrics improve.
2) Toggle kvcache bypass for >8k contexts.
3) Quota bump request; if approved, scale cache pool by +3 nodes.
4) If memory pressure persists, promote fallback model variant with lower KV requirements (gen-lite).

maria: Update: diversion at 40% now. Error rate down to 2.1%, p95 token latency improved by ~150ms, but still above baseline for long requests. Continuing monitoring.

incident-bot: Status update posted to status.redwood.com: "ap-east2: degraded generation — partial failover in effect; customers may see increased latency or timeouts. More info: https://status.redwood.com/incident/2448123456"

support: Outreach sent to impacted customers. AcmeCorp replied asking for estimated time to full restore; told them ~2 hours and that we will follow up.

docs: Status page public text (finalized):

```
We are investigating increased latency and intermittent errors in ap-east2 affecting generation workloads. We have activated partial failover to nearby regions and implemented a temporary cache bypass for long-context requests. Engineers are scaling cache capacity and monitoring. Updates every 30 minutes.```

maria: Monitoring health dashboards. If stable for 45m after mitigation we will start gradual rollback back to 0% failover.

oli: Quota bump approved (infra). Scaling cache pool now (scale +3 nodes).

maria: After scale, p95 nearly back to baseline for short contexts; long-context still 80ms above baseline but error rates under 0.5%. Good progress.

nic: Rolling back routing diversion to 15% to ease cross-region costs while stability continues.

maria: Thanks team. We'll keep the thread open until we've held stability for at least 1h post-scale. Preparing internal incident summary template for CS and Sales: short root cause, mitigation steps, timeline, customer impact, planned follow-ups.

support: I'll consolidate customer replies into a single doc and share with CS.

oli: Handing back incident to oncall (maria) for monitoring and follow-up. If any regression, re-open page and call.

maria: Closing active mitigation loop, keeping ticket open for post-incident review (postmortem owner: raj). Will update with timeline and RCA once complete. :white_check_mark:
